# Fictional Supply Act, chapter 3: delay

Section 3.1. If the seller delivers more than 14 days after the agreed date, the buyer may terminate the contract by written notice.

Section 3.2. The buyer must give the notice within 30 days after the delay became known.

Section 3.3. For each day of delay the buyer may claim a penalty of 0.5 percent of the price, but at most 10 percent of the price.

Section 3.4. The right to terminate does not apply if the delay was caused by the buyer.

Section 3.5. In this chapter, delay means that the goods are delivered after the agreed date.
